objective: Make release issues readable and maintainable through drawers with interchangeable card/list presentation.

requirements.statement: Read-only issue details are available from either view.
acceptance: Click title or detail control and read all returned issue fields without entering an editable form.
counterexample: Only maintainers can read issue descriptions through the edit form.
requirements.source: User-confirmed design and existing project contracts

requirements.statement: Create and edit issues in drawers with existing fields, validation and feedback.
acceptance: Original required fields and CLOSED timestamp rule apply; footer is reachable; failure retains input and concurrent submits are prevented.
counterexample: Create still opens the old dialog or cancellation mutates the source record.
requirements.source: User-confirmed design and existing project contracts

requirements.statement: Switch card/list presentation without losing query or pagination context.
acceptance: Current record IDs, total, page, page size and filters remain unchanged; switching alone makes no list request.
counterexample: Switching resets the page or shows a different data set.
requirements.source: User-confirmed design and existing project contracts

requirements.statement: Both views and drawers remain usable on desktop and mobile.
acceptance: Desktop defaults to list and mobile to cards on initial entry; explicit user choice survives resize; 375x812, 390x844, 430x932 and desktop have no page overflow.
counterexample: Mobile mode is forced after every resize, or drawer footer is clipped.
requirements.source: User-confirmed design and existing project contracts

requirements.statement: Preserve project isolation, service-side pagination and permission/error/cancel semantics.
acceptance: Read-only viewers can open details without write controls; project switching clears old details; cancelled deletion sends no delete request or failure message.
counterexample: A previous project's issue remains in the drawer after switching.
requirements.source: User-confirmed design and existing project contracts

invariants: One records and pagination state for both views
Details do not mutate the editing form or source record
constraints: Only modify the issue component and this task's metadata
Preserve ReleaseIssueDto/Write, projectId, rowVersion and API contracts
No backend, SQL, public UI, shared styles, router or dependency changes
No production/.env access, commit, push or branch switch

selected_approach.name: Detail and maintenance drawers plus shared-data dual views
selected_approach.reason: Preserves browsing context and avoids route changes

alternatives.name: Separate detail route
alternatives.rejected_because: Adds navigation and return steps without a requested permalink requirement

components.name: ReleaseIssueTrackingView
components.responsibility: Shared query state, issue presentation and drawer modes

interfaces.name: ReleaseIssueDto and ReleaseIssueWrite
interfaces.contract: Use full list DTO for detail; keep create/update/delete parameters and concurrency version

transitions: Open details or copied edit form
Use existing API and refresh after save
data_flows.output: Project-scoped issue data with unchanged query context

error_handling.behavior: Keep input and original validation rules

security: View entry independent of manage permission; write controls retain manage guard
performance: No new fetch on view switch or detail open
compatibility: Existing Vue/Element Plus and semantic tokens
operations: Local-only verification; no server restart required

verification_strategy.signal: Matching records, contexts and accessible drawer controls
verification_strategy.method: Build, diff review and specified desktop/mobile browser journeys including permission and write fixtures where available

assumptions.text: Current list responses contain full detail values
assumptions.basis: ReleaseIssueDto includes every long-text field and display name
assumptions.falsifier: Runtime list response omits or truncates detail fields

assumptions.text: Local browser test session can exercise relevant roles and fixtures
assumptions.basis: Existing local app and prior test session
assumptions.falsifier: Unavailable account, session or browser capability

decisions.decision: Use drawers for detail and maintenance

risks.risk: Separate view state or aliased form data drifts
risks.mitigation: Share records and pagination; copy values into the form

approval.evidence: User replied 'confirm' to the proposed design. confirmed_at is the approval recording timestamp, not an asserted message timestamp; no separate Owner approval is claimed.
